photos.file: Fallow deer in the moat of Munot Fortress (Schaffhausen Switzerland).jpg
photos.desc: Fallow deer in the moat of the Munot fortress in Schaffhausen, Switzerland.
These guys were just keeping cool on a hot afternoon. Fallow deer are native to northern Europe and the British Isles.
